blocks.text: This module gives general background on the departments found in a local assembly of the Redeemed Christian Church of God - their functions, purpose, and mode of operation - along with the spiritual, psychological, and practical qualities needed to serve well and be fulfilled in each. The goal is that every intending worker, with the Holy Spirit's help, can make an informed decision about where best to invest their energy, time, and other resources in the service of God.

An organisation can be defined as a system of coordinated activity, involving people who work together toward a common goal through a hierarchy of authority and a division of responsibilities. The RCCG is exactly this kind of organisation - with clearly defined goals, pursued through a well-structured hierarchy, a pyramid of administration, and an equitable division of labour. Every intending worker is expected to understand the church in terms of its vision, administrative structure, hierarchy, and how all of these work together toward one goal.

cards.heading: Calling: the basis of every role

blocks.text: "And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; ... for the perfecting of the saints..." - {{eph 4:11,eph 4:12,eph 4:13|Ephesians 4:11-13}}, {{1co 12:27,1co 12:28|1 Corinthians 12:27-28}}.

The church is the body of Christ - a divine, eternal organisation with a divine goal, unified regardless of denomination or name. Administrative systems may differ from church to church, but the underlying goal must be the same for all; otherwise, it isn't truly part of the body of Christ.

Within the body of Christ, the division of labour, responsibility, and administration is strictly a matter of calling - a line of duty assigned to an individual, for which they'll give account and be rewarded. Scripture, the working manual of the body of Christ, categorises callings as: Apostles, Prophets, Evangelists, Pastors, Teachers, Miracles, Healings, Helps, Government, and Diversity of Tongues, among others - {{rm 12:4,rm 12:5,rm 12:6,rm 12:7,rm 12:8|Romans 12:4-8}}. Every calling comes backed by a measure of divine ability - a spiritual gift - and a person may carry a single calling or several, depending on their measure of grace.
